scripts.static:sync: mkdir -p server/locales server/public/locales server/public/js/pages server/public/fonts && cp public/locales/*.json server/locales/ && cp public/locales/*.json server/public/locales/ && cp -R public/js/. server/public/js/ && cp fonts/kaiti-tc-bold-subset.woff2 server/public/fonts/
scripts.seed:media-local: mkdir -p server/public/media/phenomena server/public/images && cp public/images/*.jpg server/public/media/phenomena/ && cp public/images/*.jpg server/public/images/
scripts.dev: npm run static:sync && npm run seed:media-local && npm run dev:server
scripts.db:reseed: SEED_DEMO=1 SEED_RESET=1 npm --prefix server run db:seed
